text.en: While one owner praised top-notch styling and a well-groomed coat, several clients report unsatisfactory haircuts. Unhappy reviewers describe uneven trims, requests for teddy bear styles being ignored, and extreme clipping that left sensitive skin irritated and closely shorn.

Feedback concerning staff members is largely critical, despite isolated praise for dedicated stylists. Reviewers recount unhelpful interactions when asking for assistance, perceived indifference at check-in, and abrupt cancellations when arriving for previously confirmed bookings.

One pet parent commended the careful handling of a high-energy dog, but other reviewers expressed deep reservations. Reports include groomers blaming natural puppy movement for poor cuts, alleged clipper abrasions, and a perceived lack of compassion towards distressed animals.

q.en: Can grooming appointments be scheduled online?

a.en: Yes, pet owners can schedule grooming and bathing services through the online reservation system.

q.en: What occurs if a pet requires extra grooming time?

a.en: Clients advise confirming coat condition early, as heavy matting or large coats may result in appointments being rescheduled.

q.en: Does this location accept cats for grooming?

a.en: Yes, cat grooming appointments are offered alongside standard canine grooming services.

q.en: Are customized breed haircuts available for dogs?

a.en: Stylists provide breed haircuts, though pet owners emphasize giving precise instructions at drop-off to ensure desired styling.
